prerequisites.fixed_ui_app_identity: Apple Development signed Flow Tab UITest.app resolved at the user Applications boundary
prerequisites.existing_test_semantics: unchanged; only additive Behavior regressions were introduced

product_contract.initial_publication: An app-launch notification may publish the first available app and window facts immediately.
product_contract.window_convergence: The same launch schedules one bounded delayed app-scoped reconciliation so windows created after the workspace launch notification are projected without another consumer action.
product_contract.termination: A matching termination cancels the delayed launch convergence generation before obsolete app facts can be repaired.
product_contract.consumer_result: Home and Switcher consumers converge to the actual real-fixture window set from committed runtime projection evidence.

production_path: signalAppLaunched records and drains the immediate app-scoped reconciliation request.
RuntimeProjectionService marks that app's windows dirty and records a future appLaunched request.
RuntimeAppLaunchConvergenceScheduler owns one PID-keyed delayed generation on the maintenance queue.
At the convergence boundary the service re-records appLaunched, drains the ready request autonomously, and publishes the repaired projection.
signalAppTerminated cancels the PID generation before recording termination and committing removal evidence.

behavior: one launch produces an immediate app repair and one delayed app repair
both repairs target the launched PID and carry appLaunched
termination after the immediate repair prevents the delayed repair
ui: a newly launched one-window real fixture reaches a 1w Home summary without a manual refresh
a fixture whose second window appears after launch reaches a 2w Home summary
Home exposes all configured real-fixture workflow windows
standard Switcher exposes the fixture app tile and all configured window cards

root_cause.production: The workspace launch repair could run while the app had only a partial nonempty window set. Committing that payload cleared dirty state, and no autonomous later repair verified the settled window set.
root_cause.test: The existing UI assets correctly detected the publication gap but lacked a deterministic service-level regression for the delayed window-creation interval.
root_cause.classification: production lifecycle-publication defect with a lowest-layer coverage gap
